questions: Did the tremor begin suddenly or within a few days?
Has the tremor progressively worsened since it began?
Did the tremor begin after a stroke, head injury, brain operation, infection, or other neurological illness?
Do you have slowness of movement?
Does the affected arm feel stiff or rigid?
Do you have reduced arm swing on the affected side when walking?
Do you have difficulty initiating walking, turning, or stopping?
Have you noticed a reduced sense of smell?
Do you act out your dreams during sleep?
Does the tremor disappear completely during sleep?
Is the tremor worse when reaching for a target than when simply holding the arm out?
Does the affected limb ever adopt an abnormal or painful posture?
Do you have weakness, numbness, poor coordination, double vision, or speech or swallowing difficulty?
Are you taking medicines such as antipsychotics, metoclopramide, prochlorperazine, lithium, valproate, stimulants, or bronchodilators?
Did the tremor start after beginning or increasing any medication?
Do you use recreational drugs or large amounts of caffeine?
Does alcohol temporarily reduce the tremor?
Does anyone in your family have a similar tremor or Parkinson’s disease?
Did the tremor begin before the age of 40?
Have you had liver disease, psychiatric symptoms, or unexplained difficulty moving your eyes?
